item.title: Norfolk woman whose father died when she was aged three helps mark huge milestone
item.description: A Norfolk woman who lost her father at the age of three is helping to mark a major milestone with local charity Nelson's Journey.

item.title: Disappointment at fire check decision over Norfolk's large-scale battery farms
item.description: A law change call to help Norfolk fire service protect the public amid a glut of applications for large-scale battery storage farms has been rejected.

item.title: 'Big-hearted boy' looking for loving new home
item.description: Pax the German Shepherd is looking for a loving new home at Dogs Trust in Snetterton, Norfolk.

item.title: See inside bus shelter as protestors mark day SEVEN in battle to save it
item.description: Pictures have emerged showing what life is like inside the 1950s bus shelter in Station Approach in Sheringham as the protestors reach their seventh day.

item.title: 5 of the best places to go for a winter dip in Norfolk
item.description: Sheringham and Cromer are among the top Norfolk beaches, with their bathing waters being rated as "excellent"- making them perfect for a winter dip.

item.title: Norfolk artist and broadcaster lovingly lampooned by the Fast Show dies, aged 91
item.description: Obituary: Beloved Norfolk artist Alwyn Crawshaw, who was best known for his inspiring television series and instructional books introducing generations to the joy of painting, has died aged 91.

item.title: 5 public notices to be aware of in Norfolk this week
item.description: A rise in the cost of parking at a beach is among the public notices to be aware of in Norfolk this week.

item.title: 'Amazing' volunteer marks three decades helping others
item.description: A long-serving volunteer has celebrated 30 years of dedicated service with the British Red Cross Mobility Aids Team in King’s Lynn.

item.title: Christmas shopping: Visit these top farm shops and delis in Norfolk
item.description: Keep it local by discovering some of Norfolk’s fantastic farm shops, delis and more

item.title: The How Hill Holly Orchard tour and traditional wreath making workshop
item.description: A whirl of shopping, cooking and parties, Christmas is a hectic time of year. Taking time out for some festive crafting is the ideal way to slow down, savour the season and create something beautiful and unique for your home
